deposit_request_initiated_occurred.meaning: a user has initiated a deposit request via requestDeposit

yield_recorded_before_fulfill_occurred.meaning: accrued yield was recorded via adjustBalance before the deposit is finalized, increasing totalAssets and PPS

fulfill_uses_reversible_value.meaning: fulfillDeposit executes against a reversible value (a value that can later be reversed by cancelBalanceAdjustment)

fulfill_uses_irreversible_value.meaning: fulfillDeposit executes against a value that is not reversible (cannot later be reversed by cancelBalanceAdjustment)

deposit_diluted.meaning: the user's deposit suffers immediate and irreversible dilution because they overpaid for shares based on a temporarily inflated NAV
deposit_diluted.checkpoint: after fulfillDeposit and reversal of the recorded yield

assumptions: fulfillDeposit is the operation that finalizes the deposit and mints shares.
The reversible value is the yield recorded via adjustBalance that cancelBalanceAdjustment can later reverse.

unresolved.description: The intent 'fulfillDeposit must never execute against a reversible value' is a prohibition on a property of the value used; the correspondence pattern requires distinct observed and expected symbols, but the report supplies no separate expected-value observable to compare against, so the desired relation cannot be expressed as a non-tautological correspondence.
The report does not define a concrete observable that distinguishes a 'reversible value' from a non-reversible value at fulfillDeposit time; only a qualitative Boolean is available.

limitations: The safety intent is a prohibition on using a reversible value; the chosen correspondence pattern cannot express a pure prohibition without a distinct expected observable, so the I formula is left as a placeholder pending audit.
Dilution is encoded as a qualitative Boolean because the report provides no numeric share/asset quantities.
